title: Waterloo Road and the clock in the streets
excerpt: Victorian builders named streets after the latest victory. I mapped every UK street named after a battle: 367 Waterloos, 340 Almas, and in 53 of 75 towns the later battles lie farther from the centre. A clock in the streets, if a slow one.
seo_description: Every UK street named after a battle, mapped: Waterloo, Alma, Trafalgar, Mafeking. In 53 of 75 towns later battles lie farther out.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Waterloo Road and the clock in the streets' beside rings around Bristol city centre, with battle streets coloured from purple for the French wars to yellow for the world wars, and the line 367 Waterloos, 340 Almas.
